task: Develop the "Result Summary" dashboard (page.tsx) by integrating real-time database connections and implementing a post-election configuration feature.
context: Current Status: The 'page.tsx' is currently a mockup. Goal: Transform this mockup into a fully functional page connected to the real Election Event database while maintaining the existing UI/Design.

specifications.feature: - Connect data to the actual Election Event database. - Support Real-time score updates. - **Constraint:** STRICTLY preserve the existing Design and UI of page.tsx.

- **Trigger:** Add a "Display Settings" button that appears ONLY after the election event ends. - **UI Placement:** Bottom of the Election Event section. - **Configuration Options:** 1. Toggle: Show/Hide Raw Scores. 2. Toggle: Show "Winner Only". 3. Action: "Skip" displaying specific positions. - **Edge Case Handling:** 1. Handle positions with "No Candidates". 2. Handle scenarios where "Vote No" (ไม่ประสงค์ลงคะแนน) wins (Scores > Candidates).
